candidates.draft_title: Add configurable threshold-based Slack alerts for at-risk segments
candidates.snippet:
[EXTERNAL] Lorraine Petty: In an ideal world? Somebody or something taps me on the shoulder and says "hey, claims dropped below whatever line, go look."
[EXTERNAL] Lorraine Petty: Yes. Exactly that. I don't want to hunt for problems, I want the problems to find me.
[EXTERNAL] Neil Ashby: And ideally not another email I'll ignore. We live in Slack. If it hit our Slack, I'd actually see it.
[EXTERNAL] Neil Ashby: We've got a #people-ops channel. If an at-risk alert dropped there when a team's engagement fell below a threshold we set, the right three people would see it within minutes.
[EXTERNAL] Lorraine Petty: That would genuinely change how fast we react. Right now it's monthly. That could be same-day.
[EXTERNAL] Neil Ashby: That's the shape exactly. Configurable threshold, posts to Slack, so we catch the drop early instead of a month late.

candidates.draft_title: Allow per-segment configuration of engagement alert thresholds
candidates.snippet: [EXTERNAL] Neil Ashby: Just — when you build the alert, let me set the threshold per segment, not one global number. Claims and underwriting shouldn't share a line.
